segments.name: Diagnostic products
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets diagnostic test kits and therapeutic products for clinical laboratories, point-of-care settings and over-the-counter channels worldwide.
segments.evidence: We manage our operations as a 1 single operating and reportable segment, which focus on the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of diagnostic products.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by clinical laboratories, physicians' offices, over-the-counter channels and third parties for diagnostic test kits and contract development and manufacturing services.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our portfolio of diagnostic products worldwide, primarily to clinical laboratories and in point-of-care settings, including physicians' offices and over-the-counter channels.
